target: Enable traversal from a decision to its linked progress entries by adding GET /api/decisions/{decision_id}/progress REST endpoint and get_linked_progress MCP tool, so callers can retrieve all progress entries that are linked to a specific decision.
invariants: This packet must not modify the decisions or progress_entries table schemas.
The endpoint must query the entity_relationships table using linked_decision_id or the equivalent relationship edge — not perform a full scan.
Return only progress entries belonging to the same workspace as the decision; never leak cross-workspace data.
get_linked_progress MCP tool must be registered in both server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py.
The endpoint must return 404 if the decision_id does not exist.
An empty list is a valid response (200) when no linked progress entries exist.
Do not alter existing get_decisions or get_progress endpoint signatures.
Classify ambiguous join strategy as UNKNOWN until verified against schema.sql.

pr.title: feat(conport): decision-to-progress traversal endpoint and MCP tool
pr.body: Adds GET /api/decisions/{decision_id}/progress to enhanced_server.py, returning the list of progress entries linked to the given decision via the entity_relationships join. Returns 404 when the decision does not exist, 200 with an empty list when no linked progress exists. Registers get_linked_progress in server.py (tool definition + handler) and conport_mcp_stdio.py (JSON-RPC dispatch). Mirrors the registration pattern of existing get_linked_items. Depends on 202 (entity-relationship write API) being in scope.
